abstract: AIMS: Squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) is the most common form of malignant transformation in mature cystic teratoma (MCT) of the ovary. Some investigators have suggested the possibility of origin from columnar epithelium. The aim of this study was to analyse such tumours immunohistochemically to elucidate their histogenesis. METHODS AND RESULTS: The expression of cytokeratin (CK) 10 and CK18 was examined in 21 samples of SCC arising in MCT. The expression of CK10 and CK18 was also assessed in SCCs arising in different organs (skin, vulva, lung and uterine cervix) for the purpose of comparison. SCC in MCT expressed CK10 in 7/21 cases [33.3%, 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.12-0.53] and CK18 in 14/21 cases (66.7%, 95% CI 0.46-0.87). SCC in MCT expressed CK10 less frequently, but CK18 more frequently, as is the case in SCCs of the uterine cervix (CK10, 20%; CK18, 70%) and the lung (CK10, 5%; CK18, 90%), both of which are derived from columnar epithelium by squamous metaplasia. CONCLUSIONS: SCC in MCT may be derived from metaplastic squamous epithelium.
abstract_ja: 目的：扁平上皮癌（SCC）は、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（MCT）における最も一般的な悪性転化の形態である。円柱上皮に由来するという説を唱えた研究者もいる。本研究の目的は、これらの腫瘍を免疫組織化学的に解析し、組織発生を解明することである。方法と結果：卵巣MCT内に生じたSCC 21検体で、CK10とCK18の発現を検討した。比較のため、皮膚、外陰、肺、子宮頸部など他臓器に生じたSCCでもCK10とCK18の発現を評価した。MCT内のSCCではCK10が21例中7例（33.3%、95%信頼区間0.12-0.53）、CK18が21例中14例（66.7%、95%信頼区間0.46-0.87）で発現していた。MCT内のSCCはCK10の発現頻度が低くCK18の発現頻度が高く、これは円柱上皮から扁平上皮化生を経て生じる子宮頸部SCC（CK10 20%、CK18 70%）や肺SCC（CK10 5%、CK18 90%）と同様の傾向であった。結論：MCT内のSCCは化生性扁平上皮に由来する可能性がある。
